units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:6:6">Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ</cite> <he>וההן נו נשוך</he> (= <he>והָהֵנוּ</he>) this, indeed, is ‘interlaced’ (v. <cite ref="N01325"><he>נָשַׁךְ</he></cite>). Y. Naz. III, end, 52ᵈ, v. <cite ref="E00369"><he>הַיְידְּנוּ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 10:6:4">Y. Yeb. X, 11ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>וההן ני קל</he> (not <cite ref="N00411"><he>נוקל</he></cite>) is this the lighter case?
